text: Besides an optional constant term, the NVAR feature vector is built from which two components?
choices: Random reservoir states passed through a tanh nonlinearity
The eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a random recurrent matrix
Fourier coefficients of the input and their random phases
A linear part (time-delayed copies of the inputs) and a nonlinear part (polynomial products of those delayed inputs)
explanation: NVAR builds its features EXPLICITLY: a linear part (a time-delay embedding [u_t, u_{t-k}, ...]) plus nonlinear monomials (e.g. quadratic products) of those delayed inputs, and a constant. There is no random reservoir (option 0), no recurrent matrix to decompose (option 1), and no Fourier/random-feature map (option 2 — that description fits the ESN's random-feature view, not NVAR).
